reviews.x: I bought these hooks as a replacement to their predecessor which only has one hook and since both the shower curtain AND liner were on the same squeeze-to-open hook (very aggravating), changing them out was miserable. I hated it because it was very difficult to remove the liner for washing or changing. It was easier to literally remove BOTH the liner and curtain.  When I saw the double shower curtain hooks, I was sold. Now I can change out the liner and never have to bother with the curtain. EAS

Love this product.  Had a problem with my old hooks - they eventually damaged the holes on my old curtains due to tugging to close etc!!  These are great looking, roll effortlessly along the shower rod and look great.  For all of you using a shower curtain with a liner this is the way to go!

reviews.t: Makes getting in/out of the shower a breeze!
reviews.x: These are great, smooth movement and so easy to open/close the curtain!  I hated that my old hooks got stuck at the seam on the pole everytime I got in/out haha!  Wish I got these years ago!
These are great, they roll so smoothly and never stick together. The quality is great too seems to be a really solid, good quality material.

reviews.t: I like them but it was a good thing two extras ...
reviews.x: I like them but it was a good thing two extras were included since two of them were broken.  The beads just slid all the way to the bottom where the hooks are.  Not good.
They are not only good looking, but they are well designed.  I very much like being able to unhook the liner for laundering without having to remove the shower curtain.

I was not sure about these hooks since another brand received bad reviews. Instead of 12, you get 14 hooks!!!  They are nicely made with a good shine to them and they stay on securely, at least for now. One tip, put them on pole first and then put liner on next. After a few, I was putting liner on outside hook by mistake. Since I live in an older building and dont have a rounded pole that sticks out, I took the one I bought for mother after she moved and put it up with a few inches further out.

reviews.t: these are wonderful, i recently got a new apartment with my ...
reviews.x: OH MY GOODNESS! these are wonderful, i recently got a new apartment with my lovely husband and my mother blessed us with a shower rod and a curtain but we still didnt have the rings for it. and we kept forgetting to get some, or we just didnt have the money for it at that moment. so anyways when i came across these i got so excited and thought these were cute so lets try it. i got them at a discounted price in exchange for my honest unbiased review, and i bave to say again that these are amazing

reviews.t: A must have for someone that constantly changes liners and washes fabric curtains!!
reviews.x: Where have these been all my life?!? I have had these for a few months now-and I love them. I frequently change my shower curtain liner and wash my fabric shower curtain and it was a hassle with the typical shower curtain hooks. I have had metal hooks in the past and they rusted right away. So far these have shown no signs of rust, and make my life so much easier! They include 2 extra hooks-not sure the purpose of that, since they seem to be a quality product and have held up thus far. I just st

reviews.t: Who knew you could get excited about shower curtain hooks?
reviews.x: A genius invented these.  Seriously.  Where have they been all of my life?  Love the rollers at the top of the hook - easy on and off.  The dual bottom hooks are INGENIOUS!  Now we can slip the inner and outer curtain on their own individual hook, which makes replacing one curtain not being the bane of my existence for that day.  You know how it goes - your arms feel like they're falling off while you struggle to get the curtain off of the hook so you can wash it, but first, you have to fight wi

First off these hooks look great compared to the cheap plastic ones I have. I had a clear shower curtain and a cotton shower curtain both on the same plastic hooks. What a disaster! When I saw these I had to get them! It's made my life so much easier. No more broken plastic clips. It's smooth and easy to slide the curtains open. Easy to put the curtain on the hook. I should have bought these a long time ago! No more struggles trying to get in the shower

reviews.t: Easy and safe to slide with this double hook.
reviews.x: I got this double hook for my shower curtain simply because of the plastic and cloth curtain I had before kept falling and sometimes hit me in the head. It was not safe for my young children. This double hook shower curtain makes it easy to slide the curtain and take it off safely when I was changing it. I definitely gives 5 stars for this product. I received this product at a discount in exchange of my honest and unbiased review.

reviews.t: not super heavy which surprised me but still feel like they ...
reviews.x: A quality product! These are well made, not super heavy which surprised me but still feel like they will do the job for years to come. They hang nicely with the cloth curtain and vinyl liner. They roll smoothly  and are not super loud. I have plans to buy a few more sets for each bathroom. I wish I had these years ago! The set came with two extra hooks. I have a standard shower curtain.

Been using it for about a month now. Love it. No rust, works smoothly, and double-sided means I have one ornamental shower curtain on the outside, and one more functional one on the inside. Helps me give a splash of color to my apartment's bathroom. (Also, I only need 12 shower rings, but the extra 2 are nice in case one of them breaks. Nice to see companies putting thought into it. ;)

reviews.t: Work wonderfully for smooth moving across bar.
reviews.x: These work perfectly for allowing the shower curtains to hand nicely and to move across the curtain rod smoothly. I would have given it a 5 star rating, but one of the hooks was broken in two at the weld area where the curtains hang from. Fortunately I did not need all the hooks and one less hook did not hurt my hanging of the curtains. I would definitely recommend these to others.

I generally liked the double hooks and they worked as advertised; however, like other posters I received a few broken hooks. (the double hooks had detached from the main hook as the result of  poor spot welds.) and also like other posters, I had enough hooks to hang my curtains and didn't want to go through the bother of exchanging them.  It does the job but it's very cheaply made.

reviews.t: Best Shower Curtain Hook I've Ever Owned
reviews.x: These go on the rod easily Slide easily Much less likely to break than the plastic ones. They gave me 2 extras - nice of them. Match the chrome shower curtain rod. I really like that there are separate and separated hooks for the liner vs the curtain. Very reasonably priced.  Amazon has others that would probably work well, but I am very satisfied with these.

These shower curtain rings deserve 10 STARS!!! Finally a product that looks good, is durable and makes my life easier!! My bathroom shower curtain is no longer stuck in the 80's with those terrible white plastic rings that you have to fight with to make sure the curtain is hooked properly.  These rings are so easy to use and they have a nice modern look.

These shore hooks are designed so that I can easily hang a liner & decorative outer curtain with little effort they are the best design for people who want to effortlessly hang curtains in less than 15 minutes. The doubled hook is the greatest invention I've seen for hanging my shower curtains in all of my 67 years. Must try them. An excellent product!

reviews.t: Absolutely loved this shower curtain hooks
reviews.x: Absolutely loved this shower curtain hooks.  They make putting up a shower curtain and liner so easy.  Nothing to clip open and wrack your neck trying to maneuver the hooks on and off the rod.  I highly recommend them.  This is my second set.  I bought the first for a newly remodeled bathroom and loved them so much I got them for our other bathroom.

They are so easy to move on the rod!  I was always tugging and pulling on the shower curtain with my pretty but difficult curtain hooks.  These curtain hooks take the aggravation away.  I hesitated in replacing my pretty hooks but what can I say I am so happy I did and I definitely recommend these hooks and at the price Amazon offers them.

Adore these hooks. No problems with them staying on the rod - actually have to push them a bit to get them to snap on. They roll smoothly and keep a nice separation between our curtain and liner for air circulation. Went through grommet (liner) and button-hole (curtain) styles just fine. Look nice. Came with one hook too many.

reviews.t: One of a kind - Excellent Double hooks
reviews.x: One of a kind - Excellent Double hooks.  What a brilliant idea to have two separate hooks one for the main curtain & the other for lining.  Those glider balls move smooth - Kids love it.  Its sturdy unlike the other rings & looks like the NU Shower curtain double hooks gonna stay in my kids bathroom for a very long time.

Love these hooks. My second order for an additional bathroom. The the double anchor is convenient to allow washing the liner without having to bother with the curtain on a single hook design, and no unhooking a re-hooking the rings. I have had the first set for close to 2 years and no signs of rust and holding up well.

SOOO much easier than the tradition shower curtain rings. I will never go back to those. I just got these in the mail today so I can't review on their rust resistance. They also add a couple extra just in case! I could not be happier! I wish I had more to write but they basically speak for themselves.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how smoothly the hooks roll along the shower rod and how easy they make opening and closing the curtain.
Many customers highlight the dual-hook design that lets them hang a liner and curtain separately, making liner changes and laundering much easier.
Several reviewers comment that the hooks look good and are well made with solid quality materials.
A few reviewers report receiving broken hooks, with the beads sliding down or the hook broken at the weld.
Some reviewers appreciate that extra hooks are included beyond the expected count.
